ListNode.description: `val` stores the node value. `next` refers to the next node, or `None` at the end of an acyclic list. `ListNode(0, head)` creates a node with value `0` whose `next` points to `head`.

TreeNode.description: `val` stores the node value. `left` and `right` refer to child nodes, or `None` for missing children. `TreeNode(5)` creates a leaf with value `5`.

Node.description: `val` stores the node value. `neighbors` is a list of neighboring `Node` objects. `Node(1)` creates a node with value `1` and its own empty neighbor list.
